reading_scope.libbrecht_rickerby2011: Experimental setup, growth-fitting method and classical step-energy relation on pages 1-4 read; page 4 equation visually inspected. This paper measures basal surfaces at low pressure; the general circular-nucleus relation is compared with prism parameters, not its basal measurements.
reading_scope.miyamoto2022: Sections 3.1-3.3 reread, including inferred surface humidity and the BCF spiral-spacing inversion. Printed molecular area, energy units and -15.3 C peak checked against the PDF. Source bytes and earlier reading scope remain in surface_transport_sources.json.
reading_scope.takahashi1991: Original Table 1 and Figure 3 visually inspected. Warm photographs show distinct sheaths and needles; duration panels are different specimens. Methods report water saturation, approximately 0.1 g/m^3 liquid water, 8 micrometre mean droplets and most between 5 and 15 micrometres.

source_claims.classical_polynuclear_relation: sigma0 = pi*kappa^2*Omega/(3*k_B^2*T^2); Libbrecht and Rickerby 2011, page 4. Dimensionless fractional supersaturation.

prism_microscopy_peak.source: Miyamoto et al. 2022, equations 4-5 and Figure 7

source_claims.broad_prism_law: Libbrecht 2023 broad-facet limit, with source identity in spatial_growth_sources.json. Narrow-facet reduction is excluded from equilibrium-energy comparison.
